question.text: The SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations were introduced in which year?

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations were introduced by SEBI in 2012, and Chapter 4 is specifically titled on SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012. These regulations provided the necessary framework for AIFs in India. The Trap: 2012 is the year of introduction; do not confuse it with other reference years that appear in the workbook for unrelated milestones. Note: Chapter 4 of the workbook is the primary reference for the 2012 AIF Regulations.
